set -eu
ulimit -t 20
ulimit -v 524288
ulimit -f 2048
ulimit -n 128
ulimit -c 0
exec /usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 /usr/bin/timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 50s /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,signal,socket,time,urllib.error,urllib.request
assert os.geteuid()==1000
mem={x.split(':',1)[0]:x.split(':',1)[1] for x in pathlib.Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines()}
assert int(mem['MemAvailable'].split()[0])*1024>=2000000000
root=pathlib.Path('.cache/task12-pypi-roots-20261025-a')
assert not os.path.lexists(root)
root.mkdir(mode=0o700)
deadline=time.monotonic()+45
def expired(_s,_f): raise TimeoutError('absolute metadata deadline')
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,expired)
signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL,45)
class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self,*a,**k): raise RuntimeError('redirect refused')
opener=urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect)
names=[('pysigma','1.5.1'),('pysigma-backend-opensearch','2.0.3'),('pysigma-backend-elasticsearch','2.1.1')]
total=0
results=[]
phase='start'
try:
    for name,version in names:
        phase=name
        url='https://pypi.org/pypi/'+name+'/'+version+'/json'
        remaining=deadline-time.monotonic()
        assert remaining>0
        chunks=[]
        size=0
        with opener.open(urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'Accept':'application/json','User-Agent':'Warden-Task12-metadata/1'}),timeout=min(8,remaining)) as response:
            assert response.status==200 and response.geturl()==url
            while True:
                if time.monotonic()>=deadline: raise TimeoutError('absolute metadata deadline')
                chunk=response.read(min(65536,2097153-size))
                if not chunk: break
                size+=len(chunk);total+=len(chunk)
                if size>2097152 or total>6291456: raise ValueError('metadata byte cap')
                chunks.append(chunk)
        raw=b''.join(chunks)
        data=json.loads(raw)
        assert data['info']['version']==version
        wheels=[x for x in data['urls'] if x['packagetype']=='bdist_wheel']
        assert wheels and all(x['url'].startswith('https://files.pythonhosted.org/') for x in wheels)
        result={'name':name,'version':version,'json_bytes':len(raw),'json_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'requires_python':data['info']['requires_python'],'requires_dist':data['info']['requires_dist'],'wheels':[{'filename':x['filename'],'size':x['size'],'sha256':x['digests']['sha256'],'url':x['url'],'requires_python':x['requires_python'],'yanked':x['yanked']} for x in wheels]}
        fd=os.open(root/(name+'.json'),os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
        with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as out:
            out.write(raw);out.flush();os.fsync(out.fileno())
        results.append(result)
    payload=json.dumps({'scope':'metadata only; no wheels/install/import/service','results':results,'total_bytes':total},ensure_ascii=True,sort_keys=True)
    assert len(payload.encode())<=32768
    fd=os.open(root/'selected.json',os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd,'w',encoding='utf-8') as out:
        out.write(payload+'\n');out.flush();os.fsync(out.fileno())
    print(payload)
except BaseException as exc:
    print(json.dumps({'status':'FAILED','phase':phase,'type':type(exc).__name__,'detail':str(exc)[:512],'completed_roots':len(results),'received_bytes':total}))
    raise
finally:
    signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL,0)
PY
